data.narrative:
Etched is a Series C semiconductor design company founded by Gavin Uberti, Chris Zhu, and Robert Wachen. The company currently carries a $5.0B post-money valuation following $10.3B in total capital raised. Valuation analysis employs two applicable triangulation methods against a comp universe of 3 public semiconductor peers (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private-stage peers in chips and semiconductors, including d-Matrix, DEEPX, Cerebras, Credo Semiconductor, and SambaNova Systems.

Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C to next-stage advancement, yielding $8.5B. Peer-median anchoring across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Tenstorrent at $2.7B Series D, d-Matrix at $2.0B Series C, Positron AI at $1.0B Series B, DEEPX at $529M Series C) produces a median of $1.5B, with a range of $529M to $2.7B. Public-comparable P/S anchoring is not applicable; the public semiconductor sector trades at a 21.5x median P/S across three tickers, but Etched's revenue is not disclosed.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.3B (low) to $9.8B (high), with a median of $5.0B across the two applicable methods. The current $5.0B post-money aligns with the median but sits substantially above peer-median guidance. Key uncertainties include the material spread between stage-progression and peer-median signals, and the absence of revenue visibility to anchor public-market multiples.
